scope: Three L2 outcomes from live signals at S372 start: restore the daily public-surface assurance that a retired route had held red for eight days, remove two-hop legacy redirects at the edge, and route a cross-repo checker misclassification to its owner through the Ark.

items.title: Restore the daily public-surface assurance held red by a retired route
items.why: The S368 IA consolidation retired /journal/ into /changelog/#stories on 2026-10-02, but check-live-surface-matrix still required /journal/ in the sitemap. CI Health Monitor failed eight consecutive daily runs (36989006001 through 37910745305), and because the matrix aborted before its sweep, the 247-route sweep, edge smoke and Chromium public-journey smoke behind it went unexercised for eight days.
items.recipe: Require the successor /changelog/. Report missing required routes as failures instead of throwing so one stale entry cannot abort the sweep. Add a self-test that rejects any required route _redirects retires, and run that self-test in build:check. Update the Chromium smoke journey to the successor and pin the retirement redirect.

executionLog.note: Self-test 13/13 and a control with /journal/ restored fails as intended. Live matrix against the Pages origin: 247 sitemap routes, 8 public files, Desk 2026-10-09, 0 failures. smoke-live --edge-only 2/2. The masked Chromium smoke failed on the same stale /journal/ assumption; after the fix 15/15 passed on the Pages origin and the retirement journey passed on the apex.

items.informationFindingOutcome: A retired route can no longer silently hold the daily assurance red, and one missing route no longer hides every other result.
items.acceptance: Matrix self-test passes with a failing control; live matrix, edge smoke and Chromium journey smoke pass; the next scheduled CI Health Monitor run is green.

premises.claim: CI Health Monitor failed daily since 2026-10-02 with 'sitemap lacks /journal/'
premises.pattern: live surface matrix failed: sitemap lacks /journal/

L2.recipe: Successor route, non-aborting missing-route reporting, a retired-route self-test wired into build:check, and the masked Chromium journey repaired.

L3.recipe: Derive the required-route list from the navigation contract; deferred as unnecessary for the selected outcome.

items.title: Send legacy edge redirects to their final destination in one hop
items.why: The Worker sent /signal-log to /journal/ and /vaultspark-football-gm to /franchise-architect/, both of which _redirects retires, so visitors and crawlers took two 301s. The same loop appended the query after the target, which would place it inside the fragment for any hash destination.
items.recipe: Point both entries at the final destinations, insert the query before a fragment, update the redirect contract spec, and add a unit spec that fails on any Worker or _redirects rule landing on a retired route, wired into build:check.

executionLog.note: Unit spec 3/3; against the previous Worker it reports both chains. Worker syntax check passes. Live single-hop behaviour is accepted after the Worker deploy.

items.informationFindingOutcome: Every legacy redirect lands on a served page in one hop, and new chains fail the build.
items.acceptance: Chain spec passes with a failing control; after Worker deploy, /signal-log and /vaultspark-football-gm return a single 301 to their final destinations.

L2.recipe: Repoint, fix query/fragment order, update the contract spec, add a wired chain guard.

L3.recipe: Generate the Worker legacy map and _redirects from one route registry; deferred.

items.title: Route the CANON-053 checker's cache-file misclassification to its owner
items.why: check-visual-qa (owned by studio-ops) classifies any .html path as UI implementation, so a regenerated .cache/pathways-diff/propagated.html report raised an ABSOLUTE CANON-053 gap at /start with no UI change.
items.recipe: Discard the local cache churn here, and ship repo-question cargo to studio-ops proposing that generated .cache/ paths be excluded from isUiImplementationFile. Never edit the sibling tree.
items.informationFindingOutcome: A false ABSOLUTE canon gap stops recurring at the source rather than being cleared by hand each session.
items.acceptance: check-visual-qa --changed passes here; Ark cargo is shipped to studio-ops.

premises.claim: check-visual-qa reported a CANON-053 defect for .cache/pathways-diff/propagated.html

L2.recipe: Discard locally and ship owner cargo.

L3.recipe: Owner-side fix with a regression case; belongs to studio-ops.
